QuestInfo.name: [Water Wars] Requesting Air Support
QuestInfo.0: Claudine is testing a secret weapon for the Resistance. Talk to her!
QuestInfo.1:
Rumor is, Claudine is developing some kind of water-based jetpack to turn the tides of this Water War!
If the technology is ready, maybe she'll let you use it?
